authority: Principal delegated all reasonable theory decisions through run completion. These are counted model/preparation choices, not measurements or native derivations.

shared_state.b: One common positive b=beta_native*Ud for DDO154 and NGC3198; jointly independently calibrated with native ratios and dimensional scales, then frozen. No value chosen here.
shared_state.scope: Counted universal effective-equilibrium/environment hypothesis; not inferred from baryonic gas temperature. Expanded per-galaxy b remains a separate sensitivity family and cannot inherit a target b constraint from DDO154.

stellar.radial: Existing actual face-on intensity nodes, piecewise-linear intensity, reference M/L3.6=0.5 and0.4/0.6 population alternatives. Constant first-node core; continuous exponential outer tail with the saved photometric Rd. These extrapolations are explicit model assumptions, not observed exterior bounds.
stellar.vertical: rho_star(z)=Sigma_star/(4*h_star)*sech(z/(2*h_star))^2 in proper vertical distance; h_star=Rd/7.3. This chosen isothermal shape matches the primary printed Sigma=4*rho0*h convention.
stellar.height_scope: 7.3 plus/minus2.2 is a population flattening relation, not measured galaxy height or confidence coverage. Ratios5.1/9.5 and flagged photometry are explicit source sensitivities.
stellar.supersedes: Earlier .196*(Rd/kpc)^.633 height formula remains preserved as an optional named alternative, not the primary height relation.

atomic_gas.closure: Counted finite-support polytropic preparation; P=K*rho^Gamma; epsilon=rho*c^2+P/(Gamma-1).
atomic_gas.dispersion_scope: Primary Leroy AppendixB adopts11km/s;11+/-3 describes lower-inclination outer THINGS disks. Here it is a source-motivated preparation assumption, not an individual sigma_z measurement or confidence interval for either high-inclination galaxy.
atomic_gas.boundary: Solve the actual free boundary P=0 jointly with the metric. For a static lapse with asymptotic limit, strict ln(N_infinity/N0)>ln(1+h0/c^2) is necessary for finite support; no arbitrary numerical height cutoff can replace failed confinement.
atomic_gas.rotation: For circular flow with Omega constant along a column and no shift, replace N by Nrot=sqrt(N^2-Omega^2*R^2/c^2), only while timelike and with the actual proper circumferential R. Otherwise integrate the full vertical Euler equation; N-only is a declared leading weak-field approximation, not exact rotating equilibrium.
atomic_gas.source: Use the actual nonnegative complete-annulus mean inputs, helium already included once. NGC3198 all51 complete means were checked nonnegative, so no negative-mean clipping is required. Retain signed pixel and partial-support ledgers.

molecular_gas.NGC3198: Ten actual Leroy H2 rings at S1_alternative_and_stellar_median_rows/rows/0..9/components/H2 in NGC3198_MAIN_SOURCE_ANNULAR_INPUT_V001.json; already converted including helium, no extra1.36. Subsequent13 entries are missing.
molecular_gas.vertical_reference: Same normalized stellar-height tracer profile, explicitly counted source-shape assumption; the HI polytropic profile is a separate shape alternative. Neither is a measured molecular hydrostatic state.
molecular_gas.missing: DDO154 blank H2 and outer NGC3198 missing H2 remain unmeasured. Zero extra unmeasured H2 is only a named restricted reference approximation, never a nondetection bound.

uncertainty_limits: Masked HI, unknown exterior mass and missing H2 have no finite empirical bounds in the available sources. Preserve the general nonnegative nuisance family; do not report uncertainty of the restricted reference as exhaustive. State/source sensitivity belongs inside the campaign and does not authorize target-selected membership.
remaining_execution: Actual collective coefficient and spatial response evaluation, coupled gas/metric solve, independent calibration, joint region/protocol freeze and all43 predictions remain undone. The leading-source approximation does not supply any missing coefficient or physical normalization. State/source sensitivity remains inside the campaign.

supersedes_reference_binding.scope: V002 retained. V003 adds the full-metric, observed-mass-preserving source quadrature and explicit geometry/motion scope.

source_order_approximation.equation: E_normal = rho_rest*c^2 at leading order; J_N = -rho_rest*c^2*dV_proper. Retain the full native coupled response to this source. Spatial baryonic stress and kinetic/internal-energy corrections are separate explicit source columns.
source_order_approximation.counting: One declared source-order approximation, not a new fitted coefficient, measured zero pressure, a cold stellar state, or a derivation of the force law.
source_order_approximation.motion: Retain gas pressure support in the observed-motion equation. Omitting subleading stress from the leading gravitational source does not set pressure gradients or streaming velocities to zero.
source_order_approximation.uncertainty: Source corrections scale formally as v^2/c^2 and P/(rho*c^2) in the stated slow-motion regime. This alone gives no quantitative bound on the resulting metric or velocity error.
source_order_approximation.response_test: For the retained static linear system K*x=-f, delta_g_R=-c^2*d_R[e_n^T*K^{-1}*delta_f]. Evaluate stress/energy source columns with the same full operator. Near singularity, strong mixing or cancellation can amplify corrections. Use absolute sensitivity when a relative measure is ill-conditioned.
source_order_approximation.missing_inputs: Unknown stellar and H2 velocity dispersion, stress and missing exterior components remain unknown. A leading reference can be evaluated without fabricating those measurements, but an exhaustively bounded uncertainty statement cannot be claimed without explicit source bounds or a justified replacement.
source_order_approximation.shift_scope: This is a static reference source calculation. Nonzero baryonic momentum has not thereby been removed from the full shift constraints. Static even/shift decoupling requires time-reversal invariance of the complete action, preparation and boundaries and no time-odd background; the native common-phase Gibbs member alone does not establish that condition.
source_order_approximation.review_basis: Codex1 response_packet_audit separately checked the leading-source scope and transfer-error qualification in the preceding continuation; coefficient_method separately passed the full baryonic source-column implementation. No numerical physical-error bound was produced.
source_order_approximation.radial_sign_convention: g_R=c^2*partial_R(n), n=N-1, is the leading positive-inward radial acceleration convention used in response_test; R is the same physical radial coordinate in that derivative.

integration_modules.scope: Full supplied-stress SI source columns; distinct PASS_SCOPED, root-read, not yet executed.
HI moment/beam/ring and explicitly approximated thin-axisymmetric observation map; distinct PASS_SCOPED, root-read, not yet executed.
Source preparation and exact circular-fluid motion relation; existing root verification preserved.

observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.observed_measure: The adopted annular reductions specify dM=Sigma_ref(R)*R*dR*dphi in the observational/reference cylindrical chart, R and z in metres and phi in radians. This is an explicitly counted observational-to-model registration, not a claim that the source reductions already used the unknown full metric.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.metric: Retain full symmetric positive-definite g_ab(R,phi,z), including cross terms. Neither source averaging nor this registration imposes metric axisymmetry, reflection symmetry, isotropy or g_Rz=0.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.density: For each column rho=A*f, A=Sigma_ref(R)*R / integral(f*sqrt(det(g))*dz). Proper quadrature dV=sqrt(det(g))*dR*dphi*dz. Thus the adopted input mass is preserved without an extra midplane proper-area factor.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.vertical_coordinate: Tracer shape may use proper distance along a fixed R,phi coordinate thread, integral sqrt(g_zz) dz. With cross terms this is not asserted to be a normal geodesic.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.gas_scope: The previously adopted N-only polytropic shape is a leading vertical preparation. It does not solve transverse/azimuthal Euler equations in a general anisotropic field. The Nrot expression requires its stated stationary-axisymmetric circular-flow hypotheses; source averaging does not establish them.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.tails_and_axis: Noncompact tracer tails require an explicit integral in the same f*sqrt(det(g))*dz measure and a separately retained source contribution; they are not renormalized away. Finite gas support requires solved two-sided free boundaries. Use positive-radius quadrature nodes for bins reaching the cylindrical axis.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.motion_and_observation: The thin-axisymmetric observation/motion branch remains conditional on appropriate physical flow/geometry assumptions. A general anisotropic metric is not automatically a circular equilibrium or an exact published tilted-ring estimator.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.review: response_packet_audit passed the normalization, determinant, mass and scope algebra and required finite derived-output rejection. Root inspected the V002 correction that closes that requirement. No numerical metric/source solve was performed.
observational_mass_and_metric_quadrature.shape_units: f is a dimensionless nonnegative shape, e.g. sech^2(thread_distance/(2*h)) for the stellar reference. Do not include an additional 1/(4*h) normalization; A supplies the column normalization.
